questions.question: Two triangles are put together to make a square. How many sides does the square have?
questions.explain: A square has 4 sides. A common mix-up is to add 3 plus 3 from both triangles and say 6, but the new shape only has its own 4 sides.

questions.question: A square is made from two triangles. How many corners does the square have?
questions.explain: A square has 4 corners. Some kids say 3 because they think the shape is still a triangle, but two triangles make a new square shape.

questions.question: Two triangles are put together to make a square with 4 sides. Each triangle has 3 sides. How many sides do the two triangles have in all?
questions.explain: Each triangle has 3 sides, so 3 plus 3 is 6. The square has 4 sides because it is a new shape. Do not say the square has 6 sides.

questions.question: Two triangles are put together to make a square with 4 sides. The square has 1 more side than one triangle. How many sides does one triangle have?
questions.explain: The square has 4 sides. The triangle has 1 fewer, so 4 minus 1 is 3. Do not add both triangles together to get 6.

questions.question: Tom puts two triangles together to make a square. He says the square has 6 sides because 3 plus 3 is 6. What went wrong?
questions.explain: A square has 4 sides, not 6. The new shape has its own 4 sides, not the total of both triangles added together.

questions.question: Two triangles are put together to make a square. The square has 4 sides and 4 corners. How many sides and corners does the square have in total?
questions.explain: The square has 4 sides and 4 corners, so 4 plus 4 is 8. Do not add the sides from both triangles to get 6.

questions.question: You put two triangles together. You can make a square or a bigger triangle. Which one is a NEW shape that is not a triangle?
questions.explain: The square is a new shape with 4 sides and 4 corners. A bigger triangle is still a triangle, so it is not a new kind of shape.

questions.question: Two triangles can make a square. Two triangles can also make a bigger triangle. Which new shape has 4 sides?
questions.explain: A square has 4 sides. A bigger triangle still has 3 sides, so only the square has 4.

questions.question: Ava puts two rectangles together, end to end. They make one longer rectangle. How many corners does the new rectangle have?
questions.explain: A rectangle has 4 corners. The longer rectangle still has 4 corners, not 8 from both pieces added together.

questions.question: You put two square cards side by side. They make one long rectangle. How many sides does the rectangle have?
questions.explain: A rectangle has 4 sides. You do not add 4 plus 4 from the two squares, because the new shape is one rectangle.

questions.question: You put two triangles together to make a square. The square has 4 sides. How many more sides does the square have than one triangle?
questions.explain: A square has 4 sides and one triangle has 3 sides, so 4 minus 3 is 1 more. You compare the new shape to one piece, not to both pieces added.

questions.question: You put two triangles together to make a square. Then you put that square next to another square to make a rectangle. The rectangle has how many sides?
questions.explain: A rectangle has 4 sides. You do not add 4 plus 4 from the two squares, because the new shape is one rectangle with its own 4 sides.

questions.question: Two triangles can make a square. Two triangles can also make a bigger triangle. Which new shape has MORE sides?
questions.explain: A square has 4 sides and a bigger triangle has 3 sides, so the square has more. You compare the new shapes to each other, not to the original pieces.

questions.question: Ava puts two paper triangles together so their long sides touch. What new shape does she make?
questions.explain: Two triangles can fit together to make a square, so the new shape has 4 sides. Do not add 3 and 3 — the sides that touch are inside now.

questions.question: Ivy makes a paper house. She puts a triangle on top of a square so their flat sides touch. How many sides does the house shape have?
questions.explain: Count around the outside: 3 sides from the square and 2 slanted sides from the triangle make 5. The sides that touch are inside, so they are not counted.

questions.question: Ravi has two triangle blocks. He wants to make a shape with 4 sides. Can he do it?
options: No, they only make a triangle
No, the shape will have 6 sides
No, the shape will have 3 sides
Yes, they can make a square
questions.explain: Two triangles can be pushed together to make a square, and a square has 4 sides. Pieces do not have to make a bigger copy of themselves.

questions.question: Jay puts three square tiles in a row on the table. They make one long rectangle. How many corners does the rectangle have?
questions.explain: Look at the outside of the long new shape and count 4 corners. Adding up all the tile corners gives 12, but the corners where the tiles touch are inside now.
